requirement.evidence: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
requirement.note: The definition of price fixing and the enforcement clause (Division of Housing or any aggrieved private citizen to Municipal Court) both match the card.

key_value.note: The fine and community service are stated. The penalties are "one or more of" options, which also include N.J.S.A. 40:49-5 penalties. The card omits that third option.

effective_date.evidence: This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon passage and publication as provided by law.
effective_date.note: Adoption on Jul 9, 2025 is stated. Effectiveness also depends on publication, whose date is not given. The card's date is an approximation, as the extractor notes say.

status.note: The ordinance was adopted Jul 9, 2025 and no repeal appears in the document, so it is presented as current law.

coverage.note: The card's coverage field is empty.

citation.evidence: Ordinance Amending and Supplementing Chapter 158 (Rent Increases) of the Hoboken City Code by Adding a New Section 158-2, Entitled “Prohibition Against Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market”
citation.note: The title says § 158-2 and the body heading reads § 154-8, as the card states. The adoption date of Jul 9, 2025 is also supported.
